Name: Warp Parsnip
Author: AnotherPillow
Description:
This is a small mod (and my first actual C# mod that wasn't a rebrand of basically the example), which replaces parsnips with a blue warp parsnip.

Inspired by @dawngale on discord,  [url=https://discord.com/channels/137344473976799233/156109690059751424/1130990329357664256]here[/url]﻿.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bsbjIzb.png[/img]﻿
[img]https://files.catbox.moe/f4lm5l.gif[/img]

This mod only requires SMAPI, and is installed like any other mod.

Open Source at https://github.com/AnotherPillow/WarpParsnip

Downloads.Description: Replaces parsnips with warp parsnips, randomly teleporting you on eat!

Manifest.Name: Warp Parsnip
Manifest.Description: Adds a Warp Parsnip to warp you to a random location
